messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=infra-gpu-hosts -> node-host-gpu-07 unresponsive; symptom=kubelet NotReady, missing heartbeat. PD: INC12345 https://pagerduty.local/INC12345

pagerduty: incident INC12345 created -> autodoc attached (node heartbeat missing, kernel messages seen). Paging rotation: maya -> sam -> arnold

maya: acked the page. I'm oncall. pulling up node info now.

sam: same. checking serial console and metrics (node-host-gpu-07). console shows last lines: "watchdog: BUG: soft lockup" then kernel oops.

maya: running quick checks: `kubectl get nodes | grep gpu-07` -> `node-host-gpu-07   NotReady  2m   v1.28`

maya: `kubectl describe node node-host-gpu-07` -> Kubelet LastHeartbeatTime 2m ago; kernel log snippet in node-events: "kernel: panic - not syncing: fatal exception"

sam: pods on node (partial): model-infer-prod-3, redis-cache-7, metrics-agent-daemonset. Model-infer-prod has replicas in other AZs but one replica was pinned to this host. Risk: degraded throughput for tenant acme-corp.

lee: @support-elena can you check frontend error rates for acme-corp while we triage?

support-elena: looking. acme-corp errors up ~4% over baseline in last 5m, 95th latency +120ms. Not yet critical but visible. Notifying account team.

maya: plan: cordon + drain node-host-gpu-07 if safe, let workloads reschedule. If drain stalls because of long-running local-storage pods, we'll force-delete and failover. Also will attach serial console logs to infra ticket.

maya: running commands now:
```
kubectl cordon node-host-gpu-07
kubectl drain node-host-gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=30\```

sam: drain initiated. model-infer-prod started rescheduling to host-gpu-12 and host-gpu-03. monitor for OOM eviction or scheduling failures.

incidentbot: PagerDuty INC12345 -> acknowledged by maya (user:maya)

maya: @arnold FYI handing off if node not recovered in 30-45m. Are you available?

arnold: i'll take it if needed, will be online in ~20m. linking runbook: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/node-kernel-panic

sam: serial console extract (sanitized):
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRAM: temperature sensor read failed
[ 1234.568012] GPU 0000:3b:00.0: Xid 79: GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 1234.569999] kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
```

maya: that Xid79 before panic strongly suggests GPU driver/hardware fault. tagging infra.

infra-julie: received. Opening hardware ticket for host-gpu-07 (RMA probable). Requesting serial logs & full dmesg; scheduling RMA window in maintenance. Will coordinate with cloud-ops for host replacement.

lee: customer impact summary -> acme-corp: minor request failures (4%), model latency up for some requests, autoscaling absorbing most traffic. No major outages reported. Will continue monitoring dashboards.

support-elena: account notified, sending heads-up to SRE on-call and account execs.

maya: drain finished (pods evicted/rescheduled). model-infer-prod now showing target replica counts across AZs. No stuck pods.

sam: verified metrics: p50/p95 back toward baseline for most endpoints; acme-corp errors dropping.

maya: created follow-up ticket DOC-9472: investigate kernel oops frequency across fleet; assign to research & infra. Also adding staging check to see if recent driver rollout matches host.

maya: short-term mitigations: cordon node-host-gpu-07 (done), drain complete, RMA ticket opened, account notified.

arnold: taking ownership for postmortem + follow-up. I'll coordinate with infra-julie for RMA and with prod-eng for driver rollbacks if needed.

maya: thanks all. handing off incident to arnold for the rest of the day. :thumbsup:

incidentbot: Autopager closed (duration ~4m from firing to ack). Manual follow-ups remain.
